---- MODULE FunctionCube ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE nodes
Init == nodes = [node \in 1..N |-> 0]
Next == \E node \in 1..N: nodes' = [nodes EXCEPT ![node] = 1-@]
Safe == (nodes \in [1..N -> 0..1]) /\ (nodes[1]=0)
====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
